text:
The interviewer sat across from me, his eyes scanning my resume with a detached, professional air. To him, this was just another slot in his schedule, one of many candidates he would see today. He glanced at the clock on the wall, noting the time with casual indifference, unaware of the weight I placed on this moment. For me, this was the culmination of years of struggle, the single opportunity to redefine my career and prove my worth. For him, it was simply a task to be completed. As he prepared to ask his first question, I held my breath, hoping my passion would bridge the gap between our vastly different stakes in this encounter.

Regarding the priority question embedded in the original text: A typical year has 365 days.
